cards.back_text: Deck Size: 30. Deckbuilding Options: Guardian cards ([guardian]) level 0, Seeker cards ([seeker]) level 1-5, Neutral cards level 0-5, up to 5 other Seeker cards ([seeker]) level 0. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): #52-U12, Foundation Operative, 1 random basic weakness.
cards.back_flavor: Marshall's innate precision and no-nonsense attitude made him quickly rise through the Foundation's ranks, making him one of the agency's best operatives. That is, until he went "perusing" the archives and realised just how many artifacts there were blatantly stolen from Black communities: Haitian veve etchings, Gullah conjure bags, even a shard of the Benin Bronzes. Outraged, Marshall liberated the relics, while also "liberating" a couple of things for himself. While the Foundation was far from pleased, they couldn't just let go of an agent of his caliber, so they maintain an uneasy relationship, one Marshall constantly tests by pursuing his own leads.

Additional Setup: Before you draw your opening hand, search your deck for 4 copies of Stonecutter. Shuffle them into the investigators' decks, divided as evenly as possible.
cards.back_flavor: Myroslava fled Ukraine in 1919 after publishing exposes on Soviet mass graves, only to find the same rot in America. Working as a reporter, she investigated missing unionizers in Chicago and found a factory where workers chanted in a guttural tongue, their eyes sewn shut. She stole a ledger implicating the Silver Twilight Lodge in “workforce optimization”, which led her to become hunted and hide among the Hoboken dockworkers. After a fishing vessel hauled up a drowned Bolshevik agent--one she’d watched die in Kyiv--she realized that it's her job to expose tyranny in all forms--cosmic and mundane.

(Limit once per round for each option). [elder_sign] effect: +2. You may return a Weapon you control in play to your hand.
cards.back_text: Deck Size: 30 Deckbuilding Options: Rogue cards ([rogue]) level 0, Guardian cards ([guardian]) level 1-5, Neutral cards level 0-5, up to 5 other Guardian cards ([guardian]) level 0. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Brandish, Ennui, 1 random basic weakness.
cards.back_flavor: As an heir to a wealthy and unscrupulous family, Maximillian Blackwood always had things go easy for him. His life had next to no difficulties or challenges, in part due to his natural talent, but also because any issue could be resolved via connections or money of his parents. Throughout it all, Max craved something to actually challenge him, so when people involved with the Blackwoods started disappearing, he didn't dismiss it as just more of the family's shady business practices. His concerns were soon proven correct, as buildings, things, and entire accounts of history followed suit--seemingly unnoticed by everyone, except Max himself. Now he knew, this right here was his chance to prove his competence and get to the bottom of this mystery. And crack a few skulls along the way.

Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): 2 copies of Asking for Trouble, The Real Deal, 1 random basic weakness.
cards.back_flavor: Morgan's childhood in New Orleans' gutters taught them to mimic the "voodoo" magic the tourist enjoyed so much. The cons came easy to them, and soon enough it became clear why--Morgan Vale indeed had real magical powers. Yet, since Morgan never put much thought into improving their talents, their spells and rituals continued destabilizing reality, all the way until a wormhole was pierced right through it, and disturbingly familiar face emerged out of it. Morgan escaped New Orleans to try and fight their fate and learn more about the cosmic things that were encroaching upon them from the broken timelines. There's no worry on their mind. Morgan thrives under pressure.

Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Oneness, Three Pounds of Flax, 1 random basic weakness.
cards.back_flavor: Mae’s faith died with her family’s tenement, torched by Klansmen in 1915. Drifting between hobo jungles, she traded labor for odd jobs: stitching wounds, reading palms, once even assisting a defrocked priest’s exorcism. After a while, she found an almost supernatural calmness in contemplating everything she lost, which led to her perceiving things that weren't wholly there. The closer to rock bottom she was, the more clear they were--wailings of the departed, begging for her help. Mae took it upon herself to help put their spirits to rest, and realized she has quite a knack for it. The spirits told Mae of a storm brewing in Arkham, and she's determined to face it head-on.

cards.text:
Commit only to a test you are performing.
If this skill test is successful, you may put an asset with printed cost of X or lower into play from your hand. X is the amount you succeeded by. Then, reveal a random chaos token from the chaos bag. If you reveal a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], [elder_thing], or [auto_fail] symbol, place 1 doom on that asset.

cards.name: Familiar Spirit
cards.text: You have 1 additional arcane slot, which can only be used to hold a Spell asset.
cards.flavor:
"Thou aren't wholly unworthy.
I shall guide thee henceforth."

cards.name: Open the Circle
cards.text: Uses (1 charge for each [mystic] card you conrol, including this one, up to 5). [reaction] When a card effect would cause you to use [willpower] instead of another skill, exhaust Open the Circle and spend 1 charge: Ignore that aspect of the effect. If that skill test is successful, search the top 6 cards of your deck for a Spell card and draw it.

cards.name: Treads of Fleeting Daybreak
cards.text: Limit 1 Footwear per investigator. You get +1 [agility]. [reaction] After you succeed at a skill test during the mythos phase, exhaust Treads of Fleeting Daybreak: Move to a connecting location.

cards.name: Apprentice
cards.text: You get +1 [willpower]. Forced - After Apprentice enters play, put 1 doom on it. [reaction] After you play a Spell event or take an action on a Spell asset you control in play, exhaust Apprentice: Take a basic action as if it were your turn.
cards.flavor: "One more case like this and I'm out. This time I'm serious."

cards.name: Channel
cards.text: Uses (5 charges). Forced – After Channel enters play: Search your bonded cards for an Apparition asset and put it into play. When Channel leaves play, choose an Apparition asset you control in play, and set it aside, out of play. [action] Spend 1 charge: Activate a Special ability on an Appartition you control. You get +1 [willpower] while resolving that ability.

cards.name: Crystal Pendulum
cards.text:
You get +1 [willpower].
[reaction] After a skill test at your location begins, exhaust Crystal Pendulum: Name a number. If this test succeeds by that number or fails by that number, draw 1 card and gain 1 resource.

cards.name: Backup Plan
cards.text:
Fast. Play after you fail a skill test during a fight, investigate, or evade action.
Take a basic fight, investigate, or evade action. Add your [willpower] to your skill value for all skill tests during that action. If you succeed, attempt the test you initially failed again.
cards.flavor: "I'm out of mana, not out of options."

cards.name: Alter Fate
cards.text: Choose up to three non-weakness treacheries in play that are not attached to Elite enemies. Shuffle them into the encounter deck.
cards.flavor: We seal our own fate.

cards.name: Meditative Trance
cards.text: For each of your arcane slots that is filled, heal 1 damage and 1 horror.
cards.flavor: You let your mind drift into cold, meaningless oblivion. The emptiness feels like home.

cards.name: Rule of Threes
cards.text:
Myriad. Max 1 commited per skill test.
During the "reveal chaos token" step, reveal 3 chaos tokens instead of 1. Of the revealed tokens, choose and cancel 2 non-[auto_fail] tokens, or 1 [auto_fail] token.
If [elder_sign] is canceled during this test, you may draw 3 cards or gain 3 resources.

cards.name: Channel
cards.text: Uses (6 charges). Forced – After Channel enters play: Search your bonded cards for an Apparition asset and put it into play. When Channel leaves play, choose an Apparition asset you control in play, and set it aside, out of play. [action] Spend 1 charge: Activate a Special ability on an Appartition you control. You get +2 [willpower] while resolving that ability.

cards.name: Time Stop
cards.text: Choose and take any amount of different actions of the following, in any order (draw, resource, move, investigate, fight, engage, evade, activate, play, resign, and parley). Playing Time Stop and taking these actions does not provoke attacks of opportunity.
cards.flavor: If you can't make the most out of any given moment, you don't deserve a single extra second.

cards.name: Handwraps
cards.text: You get +1 [combat] while fighting. [reaction] After you defeat an enemy, exhaust Handwraps: Search the top 6 cards of your deck for an Innate skill and add it to your hand. Shuffle your deck.

cards.name: Traveler's Cloak
cards.text: You get +1 [agility] while evading. [reaction] When Traveler's Cloak is defeated or discarded from play or from your hand: Automatically evade a non-Elite enemy at your location.

cards.name: Treasured Letters
cards.text:
You get +1 [intellect] while investigating.
[reaction] After you discover 1 or more clues, exhaust Treasured Letters: Gain 1 resource.
cards.flavor: You made them a promise. You'll get to the bottom of this. Keep on keeping on.

cards.name: Backup Plan
cards.text:
Fast. Play after you fail a skill test during a fight, investigate, or evade action.
Take a basic fight, investigate, or evade action. If you succeed, take a basic action of the same type as the one you initially failed.

cards.name: Minor Epiphany
cards.text:
Fast. Play only during your turn and only if you have performed at least 3 basic actions this round.
Discover 1 clue at your location or a connecting location.
cards.flavor: You are untethered.

cards.name: Brute Force
cards.text:
Max 1 committed per skill test.
While Brute Force is committed during a basic fight action, it gains "If this test is successful by 1 or more, this attack deals +1 damage."

cards.name: Expeditious Retreat
cards.text:
Max 1 committed per skill test.
While Expeditious Retreat is committed during a basic evade action, it gains "If this test is successful by 1 or more, you may automatically evade another enemy at your location."

cards.name: Sharp Vision
cards.text:
Max 1 committed per skill test.
While Sharp Vision is committed during a basic investigate action, it gains "If this test is successful by 1 or more, discover 1 additional clue at this location."

cards.name: Track Shoes
cards.text: Limit 1 Footwear per investigator. You get +1 [agility]. [reaction] After you move, but before enemies at your new location engage you, exhaust Track Shoes: Move to a connecting location.

cards.name: Give It Your All
cards.text:
Max 1 committed per skill test.
Commit only to a test you are performing of any type.
Double your base skill value for this test.
cards.flavor: "I'm in, one-hundred-percent! That's everything, right?"

cards.name: Streamline
cards.text: [reaction] After Streamline is discarded (from anywhere): Draw 1 card or gain 1 resource.

cards.name: Heretical Scripture
cards.text: [action] Exhaust Heretical Scripture: Investigate. You get +1 [intellect] for this test. If succeed, you may discard 1 card from your hand to return a card you committed to this test to your hand instead of discarding it when the test ends.

cards.name: Traveler's Cloak
cards.text: You get +1 [agility] while evading (+2 [agility] instead during a basic evade action). [reaction] When Traveler's Cloak is defeated or discarded from play or from your hand: Automatically evade a non-Elite enemy at your location.

cards.name: True Self
cards.text: Limit 1 per deck. [reaction] After you fail a skill test, if an Innate skill you own is committed to that test, discard True Self: Draw 2 cards, gain 2 resources, and record in your Campaign Log that "you have found your true self." Next to this, in parentheses, record the amount you failed by.

cards.name: Weight On Your Shoulders
cards.text: [reaction] After you discard Weight On Your Shoulders from your hand: Search the top 9 cards of your deck for up to 2 Innate skills, draw them, and shuffle your deck.

cards.name: Guided by the Unseen
cards.text:
Uses (4 secrets).
[free] During a skill test at your location, spend 1 secret: The performing investigator may search the top 6 cards of their deck for a card that can be committed to this test and commit it. Shuffle the performing investigator's deck. (Limit once per test.)

cards.name: Handwraps
cards.text: You get +1 [combat] while fighting (+2 [combat] instead during a basic fight action). [reaction] After you defeat an enemy, exhaust Handwraps: Search the top 9 cards of your deck for an Innate skill and add it to your hand. Shuffle your deck.

cards.name: Faithless Looting
cards.text:
Fast. You may play Faithless Looting from your discard pile. If you do, remove it from the game after resolving its effects.
Draw 2 cards, then discard 2 cards from your hand.
cards.flavor: "God has abandoned us! We have nothing left except what we can take!"

cards.name: Treasured Letters
cards.text:
You get +1 [intellect] while investigating (+2 [intellect] instead during a basic investigate action).
[reaction] After you discover 1 or more clues, exhaust Treasured Letters: Gain that many resources.
cards.flavor: Keep on keeping on.

cards.name: True Self
cards.text: Researched. Limit 1 per deck. Uses (X charges). X is the number in parentheses next to "you have found your true self." You get +1 [willpower], +1 [intellect], +1 [combat], and +1 [agility]. Forced - When you are dealt damage and/or horror, spend 1 charge: Cancel 1 of that damage or horror. If True Self has no charges, discard it.

cards.name: Custom Ammunition
cards.text: Fast. Play only during your turn. Name a Monster enemy and attach to a Firearm asset controlled by an investigator at your location. Place 2 ammo on that asset. Limit 1 per asset. Attacks performed by attached asset deal +1 damage against the named enemy.

cards.name: Frantic Search
cards.text: Draw. Draw 2 cards instead of 1. If you have no actions remaining, draw 1 additional card.

cards.name: Tight Schedule
cards.text: [reaction] After you successfully fight or investigate by 2 or more, exhaust Tight Schedule: Move to a connecting location.
cards.flavor: The deadline was yesterday.

cards.name: Light Cavalry Saber
cards.text: [action]: Fight. Either use your [agility] or get +1 [combat] for this attack. [reaction] After an enemy engages you, exhaust Light Cavalry Saber: Fight that enemy with the above ability.

cards.name: Lupara
cards.text: Uses (2 ammo). [action] Spend 1 ammo: Fight. You get +1 [combat] and deal +1 damage for this attack. If Lupara entered play this turn, you get an additional +1 [combat] for this attack.

cards.name: #88-EB1
cards.text:
Exceptional. Uses (1 ammo). Replenish this ammo at the start of each round.
[free] Exhaust #88-EB1: Move 1 ammo from #88-EB1 to an asset you control.
cards.flavor: Subject Class: Yellow / Subject seems to always provide appropriate ammunition for what's currently on one's mind, as long as they're not looking inside. Gets stressed if questioned.

cards.name: Guided by the Unseen
cards.text:
Uses (3 secrets).
[free] During a skill test at your location, spend 1 secret: The performing investigator may search the top 3 cards of their deck for a card that can be committed to this test and commit it. Shuffle the performing investigator's deck. (Limit once per test.)

cards.name: Hands-on Experience
cards.text: Fast. Play only during your turn. Put Hands-on Experience into play and attach an Innate skill from your hand to it. Forced - At the start of a skill test you are performing: Commit the attached skill, if able. Do not discard it when the test ends. Forced - When your turn ends: Discard Hands-on Experience.

cards.name: Buddhavacana
cards.text:
[reaction] After Buddhavacana enters play: Search the top 9 cards of your deck for up to 3 skills, attach them facedown to Buddhavacana, and shuffle your deck.
[reaction] After a chaos token is revealed during a skill test at your location, exhaust Buddhavacana: You may commit an attached skill to this test.
If there are no skills attached to Buddhavacana, discard it.

cards.name: Phantom Blade
cards.text: Uses (3 charges). [action]: Fight. You must use either [willpower] or [agility] instead of [combat] for this attack. As an additional cost to initiate this ability, you may spend 1 charge. If you do, you gain +1 skill value and deal +1 damage for this attack.

cards.name: Twila Katherine Price
cards.text:
Uses (2 inspiration).
[reaction] After you spend 1 or more uses from an asset, spend 1 inspiration and exhaust <name>: Replenish 1 of its uses.

cards.name: Wish Upon a Star
cards.text:
Fast. Play after a non-[auto_fail] token is resolved during a skill test at your location. Group limit 1 in play.
Put <name> into play, search the chaos bag for that chaos token, and seal it here.
[reaction] When you resign or the game ends, if the [elder_sign] token is sealed on <name>: Before the next scenario, you may purchase a new level 3 or lower card at no experience cost.

cards.name: Zazen
cards.text: [reaction] After Zazen enters play: Heal 1 damage and 1 horror from an investigator or Ally asset at your location. [reaction] After Zazen is discarded from play or from your hand: Heal 1 damage and 1 horror from an investigator or Ally asset at your location.

cards.name: Alter Fate
cards.text: Choose a non-weakness treachery in play that is not attached to an Elite enemy. Shuffle it into the encounter deck.
cards.flavor: We run from our own fate.

cards.name: Path to Enlightenment
cards.text: [reaction] After you succeed at a [willpower] test, or fail a test during a basic action you are performing: Place 1 resource (from the token pool) on Path to Enlightenment, as a secret. Forced – After the fourth secret is placed on Path to Enlightenment: Discard Path to Enlightenment, gain 4 resources, and search the top 9 cards of your deck for up to two Spell and/or Innate cards and draw them.

cards.name: Capable
cards.text:
Max 1 committed per skill test.
While Capable is committed during a basic action, it gains "If this test is successful by 1 or more, gain 2 resources."

cards.name: Last Resort
cards.text: Search the top 9 cards of your deck for an asset with printed resource cost X or lower, put it into play, and shuffle your deck.
cards.flavor: "I'll take any help I can get."

cards.name: Capable
cards.text:
Max 1 committed per skill test.
While Capable is committed during a basic action, it gains <wild><wild> and the text: "If this test is successful by 2 or more, gain 3 resources."

cards.name: Overtime
cards.text:
Overtime gains fast if you have no actions remaining.
Choose and take two of the following basic actions, in any order (move, investigate, fight, evade).

cards.name: Strength · VIII
cards.text:
[reaction] When you initiate an attack during a basic fight action, exhaust <name>: You get +1 [combat] and deal +1 damage for this attack.
[reaction] When the game begins, if <name> is in your opening hand: Put it into play.

cards.name: Unsolicited Advice
cards.text:
You must commit Unsolicited Advice to each eligible skill test at your location.
This skill's icons subtract from the performing investigator's skill value instead of adding to it.
If this test succeeds, return this skill to your hand.
